title: Leadership
summary: How authority and guidance are earned within the community.
body: Leadership within Murle communities is distributed across several roles rather than concentrated in a single authority. Spiritual leaders, age-set elders, and clan heads each contribute to decision-making on different matters.

Respect is earned through demonstrated wisdom, fairness, and service to the community rather than assumed through position alone. Public consultation and consensus-building are valued parts of resolving important issues.
This distributed model has allowed Murle communities to adapt leadership structures flexibly while maintaining continuity of core values across generations.
